help:
Usage: terax agent [--cwd PATH] [--model PROVIDER/MODEL] [--resume SESSION] [--list] [--full-access]
Enter: send · Shift+Enter: new line · Escape: stop · Ctrl+C: stop or exit · Ctrl+R: retry save
Use the desktop provider settings, or pass --model and TERAX_API_KEY. TERAX_NATIVE_HOST selects the native host executable.
invalidModel: Use a known provider and model: --model provider/model-id.
missingModel: Choose a default model in desktop settings, or pass --model provider/model-id.
missingKey: The selected provider needs a credential. Configure it in the desktop app or set TERAX_API_KEY for this process.
ttyRequired: The Agent interface requires an interactive terminal.
title: Terax Agent
keys: Enter send · Shift+Enter newline · Esc stop · Ctrl+C stop/exit · Ctrl+R retry save
approvalKeys: Y approve · N deny · PageUp/PageDown scroll
saveFailed: Session save failed. Ctrl+R retries; Ctrl+C exits without retrying.
empty: Ask a question or describe a task. Your working directory stays fixed for this session.
unknownCommand: Unknown command. Use /exit to leave or terax agent --list to list sessions.
